Der Knopf mit der Blende öffnet die Kame: The button with the aperture opens the camera settings. At the top you choose the camera, below that “Fill” or “Whole image”. “Whole image” shows the full field of view and allows the largest drawing. Use two fingers to move and zoom the camera image.
Der Knopf oben rechts stellt scharf. Tip: The button at the top right focuses. Tap with two fingers at once to lock the exposure for that spot – good for dark paper and for time-lapse. Tap “Exposure locked” to release it.

Der Regler „Vorlage“ stellt ein, wie krä: The “Template” slider sets how strongly it shows over the paper. The arrow button rotates it by 90 degrees, the button next to it saves it to your photos the way you set it up.
Der Schnappschuss liegt über dem Kamerab: The snapshot lies over the camera image. Place your sheet so both line up – or let LiCida move the template to fit.
